thesis: Range Resources signed a definitive all-stock merger agreement with EQT, announced Oct 26, 2026 (EQT 8-K/425). Each Range share converts into 0.987 EQT shares, about $54.91 at announcement (a 20.6% premium). Both boards approved unanimously, and closing is targeted for Q1 2027. EQT fell after the announcement, and Range's $53.57 now tracks the exchange ratio (0.987 x EQT's $54.85 is about $54.14). That suggests its upside is tied to EQT's share price and a narrow spread rather than to Range's own fundamentals. A 2021 securities class action over inactive-well classification has no scheduled ruling identified, and this run found no restatement.
invalidation: The merger breaks, or a competing bid above the exchange-ratio value emerges.

thesis: Surgery Partners agreed on Oct 26, 2026 to be acquired by HealthSpan Partners, an affiliate of Bon Secours Mercy Health, for $23.50 per share in cash. That is about a 49% premium to the $15.75 prior close. Bain Capital affiliates, which own about 39%, are rolling their stake rather than selling. The deal has committed debt financing with no financing condition and is expected to close in Q1 2027, subject to antitrust and shareholder approvals. At $23.25 the stock sits about 1.1% below the deal price, so upside appears capped while a deal break would expose it to a large drop. Law-firm investigations announced in Nov 2025 and Mar 2026 have no filed claim identified, and the June 2026 10-Q reports no material proceeding.

Instacart rose about 7.8% today to $60.86 on 8.5x volume, extending Friday's 9% jump. The trigger was a WSJ report, relayed by Reuters, that DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire it, with a deal possibly this week and talks with Uber no longer active. The company has not confirmed anything (it declined to comment), and terms are undisclosed. A combination would face significant antitrust scrutiny, and similar talks in 2021 collapsed partly over regulatory concerns, so the outcome is unresolved. The FTC also has an open civil investigative demand over the company's AI pricing tool, with no scheduled next step identified; it follows a $60M FTC settlement in Dec 2025. This run found no restatement.
invalidation: A signed, company-announced agreement with disclosed terms and a credible regulatory path.

thesis: Ultrapar fell about 15.9% today to $6.555 on 3.0x volume. Brazilian equities crashed after Lula's election win (EWZ down about 21%, with the B3 circuit breaker triggered), a macro-wide move. A single non-wire write-up also attributes part of the drop to a sale of roughly 7.6M shares by a Patria-affiliated holder, which this run could not confirm in a filing. Q3 results are expected around Nov 11. This run found no restatement and no scheduled legal action naming Ultrapar.
invalidation: A company-specific positive disclosure, such as Q3 results with fuel-distribution margins holding, once Brazilian markets stabilize.

thesis: Northwest Bancshares reported Q3 2026 after the close today (8-K). GAAP net income was $51M, or $0.34 per diluted share, down about $3M from Q2's $0.36. Adjusted EPS of $0.35 was in line with the roughly $0.35 consensus. On the positive side, total revenue and net interest income were records, average commercial and industrial loans grew 31% year over year, and annualized net charge-offs were 0.15%. The results are mixed: record revenue and solid credit are offset by a sequential earnings decline and an in-line adjusted print. Today's 3.2x volume came before the release, so the market's read is not yet known. This run found no 2026 lawsuit, investigation or restatement naming the company.
invalidation: The Oct 27 call and market reaction show a clear positive read, such as margin expansion or a raised outlook.

thesis: Select Water traded 2.7x volume today and rose about 3.3% to $18.735, but this run found no company announcement dated today. The supporting facts are older. On Sep 24 it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Pilot Water Solutions for $600M cash plus $100M of Select stock and a contingent $15M milestone, with closing expected in Q4 2026. The deal is funded by $900M of 7.625% senior notes due 2034, upsized from $800M and issued Oct 21. Any notes above $450M must be redeemed if the deal has not closed by Mar 1, 2027. The debt-funded deal raises leverage, the $100M stock component is a pending share issuance, and what is driving today's move is unresolved. This run found no lawsuit, investigation or restatement.
invalidation: The Pilot acquisition fails to close, Q3 results show the added debt straining cash flow, or the stock closes back below its 200-day average.

thesis: dLocal traded 2.5x volume today and fell about 4.1% to $14.445. Brazil-exposed fintech and bank ADRs sold off after Lula's election win (XP, StoneCo and Nu fell roughly 25-49%). This run found no dLocal-specific announcement, so the move appears macro-driven. In April 2026 a New York appellate court unanimously affirmed the dismissal of a state securities class action. A 2023 federal class action (E.D.N.Y.) has no scheduled ruling identified. A 2023 report of an Argentine probe, which the company called misleading, has no confirmed finding.
invalidation: A company-specific positive disclosure, such as Q3 results with payment volume growth intact, once Latin American markets stabilize.

thesis: Held position (opened Oct 19). This run found no new company disclosure. thesis: Held position (opened Oct 20). CLF fell about 3.8% today to $13.37, still above the ~$12.12 pre-report level, and this run found no new company disclosure. The thesis rests on the Oct 19 Q3 report: adjusted EBITDA of $612M against $575M guidance, Q4 guided to about $715M, and 2027 guided above $4B. The counter-cases named in the prior thesis remain open. The outlook depends on contract changes and steel-price forecasts, and the Hamilton (Stelco) layoffs confirmed Oct 21 point to tariff pressure on the Canadian unit. This stays medium.
invalidation: Steel prices or contract pricing weaken enough to put the Q4/2027 EBITDA outlook at risk, a confirmed material Stelco shutdown or forced sale, or a close back below the pre-report level (~$12.12).

thesis: Held position (opened Oct 22). ROIV slipped about 1.2% to $36.06, above its ~$34.92 pre-announcement level, and this run found no new company disclosure. The thesis rests on the Oct 21 CLARITY Phase 3 results for brepocitinib in non-infectious uveitis. The June 2026 10-Q said the dermatomyositis launch was on track for the end of September 2026, and Phase 3 work is under way in cutaneous sarcoidosis and lichen planopilaris. The counter-case named in the prior thesis remains open: the uveitis sNDA is not planned until 1H 2027, so approval for this indication and its commercial weight are still pending. Fiscal Q2 results on Nov 9 are the next scheduled event. This stays medium.
invalidation: Full CLARITY data or FDA feedback reveal a safety or efficacy problem, or a close back below the pre-announcement level (~$34.92).

thesis: Held position (opened today). RNG rose about 3.5% to $86.35, and this run found no new company disclosure. The thesis rests on the Oct 22 Q3 2026 report (8-K). Revenue rose 5.9% to $676M, above the $664-670M guidance, and the non-GAAP operating margin reached 24.7%, up about 190bp. Full-year guidance was raised to $2.650-2.657B in revenue, $5.07-5.12 in non-GAAP EPS and $620-630M in free cash flow. ARR from customers using a paid AI product doubled to nearly 15% of the total. The strongest counter-case is competitive: growth is only about 6% in a crowded cloud-communications market. That doesn't change the read, because the beat, the margin expansion and the raised EPS and free-cash-flow guidance all come from the company's own disclosed results at that growth rate. This is the counter-case named and resolved in the prior thesis, and no new fact reopens it. A January 2026 law-firm investigation notice has no filed claim, the 10-Q shows no material proceeding, and the next earnings report is about 78 trading days away.
invalidation: Q4 revenue or margin falls short of the raised guidance, or a close back below the pre-report level (~$79.42).
